# dependabot-dep

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Automated dependency management for Ruby, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Elixir, Rust, Java, .NET, Elm and Go

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/dependabot-dep/0.158.0
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/dependabot-dep
